title: Colorado Front Range viewed from Broomfield

elevation.author: U.S. Geological Survey, 3D Elevation Program
elevation.product: 1 arc-second Digital Elevation Model, NAD83, elevations in metres

surface.author: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map
surface.changes: Resampled orthophotography, shaded with DEM slope and aspect, and illustrated high-elevation November snow cover.

registration.projection: EPSG:3857, locally scaled by cosine of origin latitude; east is +X and south is +Z
registration.notes: Mesh vertices retain measured elevations. Distant-relief rendering applies curvature and a gradual 1.12× to 1.82× vertical emphasis for legibility at the game's wide field of view. Snow extent is seasonal artwork.
